description: What this credential is and what it may do: a bot link (you report and act as one bot), the office access code (the owner: you may mint bot links and office codes) or a team link (reporting only), with the office id and name, your desk when you have one, the event count and the next steps for you. Call it first when you are unsure which link you were given. Example: {} (no arguments). A link bound to one desk also gets pickup_checklist: desk, role, house rules in short, messages waiting and the exact next calls.
name: whoami
title: Who am I
